In an estimation of bromine by Carius method, 1.6 g of an organic compound gave 1.88 g of AgBr. The mass percentage of bromine in the compound is _______.
(Atomic mass, Ag = 108, Br = 80 g mol–1)
en.explanation:
Mass of organic compound = 1.6 gm

Mass of AgBr = 1.88 gm

Moles of Br = Moles of AgBr = = 0.01

Mass of Br = 0.01 × 80 = 0.80 gm

% of Br = = 50 %

en.content:
Two families with three members each and one family with four members are to be seated in a row.
In how many ways can they be seated so that the same family members are not separated?
en.explanation:
F1 3 members
F2 3 members
F3 4 members

Total arrangements of three families = 3!

Arrangement between members of F1 family = 3!

Arrangement between members of F2 family = 3!

Arrangement between members of F3 family = 4!

Total numbers of ways can they be seated so that the same family members are not separated

= 3! 3! 3! 4!

= (3!)3.(4!)
